assessment.behaviour_change: submitForm now branches on the route slug. With a slug (/editor/:slug) it calls articleService.update, which sends PUT. Without one (/editor) it still calls create, which sends POST. Before this change, editing sent a create request, so the edit path is the one that changed. The create path is functionally unchanged apart from refactoring.
